states: Production AlertsConfigurationSurface, real state owners, payload builders, API adapters and CSS against synthetic local endpoints; Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock. Chromium 141.0.7390.37 and WebKit 26.0, light/dark desktop and narrow viewports.
One click-time policy/destination snapshot while the policy PUT and Apprise reply are deferred. Saving… and aria-busy remain visible; Save and Discard are disabled. Fields remain editable.
Newer SMTP/Apprise drafts and dirty status survive older acknowledgements and settings-tab navigation without a replacement GET. Failure retains the draft and restores Save for a deliberate retry.

Twelve pending/newer-draft/rejected captures inspected across all four variants. Save controls and unsaved notice fit at 320px/390px with no horizontal overflow; inherited panel descriptions still truncate at narrow widths.

The fixture does not mount the global toast layer or prove native SMTP/Apprise delivery, tenant operations, physical-phone, release or installed acceptance. The state tests cover newer-unsaved acknowledgement copy and context invalidation.
interactions: 32 assertion groups: keyboard Save; prevent duplicate click and Discard; edit during both pending requests; switch settings tabs; verify exact click-time wire fields; preserve newer inputs and dirty status.

Reject Apprise after email acknowledgement: no later watchdog write, draft retained, Save restored. Deliberate retry clears dirty status only after all writes; explicit idle Discard reloads accepted settings. Earlier accepted writes are not atomic rollback.
